# spoke_static_application (Data Source)

Observe an exact application declaration in an explicitly configured project. Requires read authority, never claims management ownership and never provisions hosted delivery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use an existing exact application ID in a project-scoped provider.
data "spoke_static_application" "site" {
  resource_id = "123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Exact decimal application ID.

### Read-Only

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Observed deletion policy.
- `id` (String) Canonical scoped application identity.
- `name` (String) Observed application label.
- `readiness` (String) Observed runtime readiness.
- `reason` (String) Observed readiness reason.
- `retention_days` (Number) Observed retention policy.
- `revision` (String) Observed decimal declaration revision.
